about: The Fresh-Start Mochi used from the bag, as the ninth generation's (Pokemon Central, Mochi del ripristino: it sets all of a Pokemon's EVs to zero): route29-official.sav's Chikorita, no EVs, given thirteen Health Mochi, a Swift Mochi and a Fresh-Start Mochi (savedit --item). use: gives it the thirteen Health Mochi, 130 HP EVs -- more than the 128 hg-engine's -128 took away, which left 2 before TryModEV read -128 as a reset -- and the Swift Mochi, 10 Speed EVs; then the Fresh-Start Mochi, "CHIKORITA's base points were all reset to zero!": all six EVs 0, the Mochi spent.
